description: Read promotional offers resolved for one public-catalogue Mercury motor. motorId is required. purchasePath, when sent, must be loose or installed. It is echoed and does not change eligibility or the amount. HBW staff choose what to apply. The current rate, term, minimums and fee come from the live response. Mercury TD Always On is a promotional rate on approved credit (OAC) through DealerPlan, not a standing-rate amortization line, and it ends when this feed stops returning it. This feed does not include standing financing tiers. Compare minimumBeforeTaxCents with the quote's before-tax subtotal after rebates and trade. When minimumAmountFinancedCents is present, compare it with the amount financed, including HST and the DealerPlan fee. Eligibility depends on the configured quote. The financing.eligible field is null in this feed. Use build_quote to check the selected configuration. Never show a term the program does not offer. Do not reuse a rebate for a different horsepower. Does not apply an offer or write anything.

motorId.description: UUID of a public-catalogue Mercury motor

purchasePath.description: Echoed only. Does not change eligibility or the amount.

name: get_promotions
